name: EZ Bar Anti-Gravity Press
steps: Set an adjustable bench to roughly a 45-degree incline and lie chest-down on the pad with your feet planted firmly on the floor behind you.
Grip an EZ bar with an overhand shoulder-width grip and bring it up in front of your shoulders with your elbows bent.
Press the bar forward and up in line with your torso until your arms straighten.
Lower the EZ bar slowly back to shoulder level with strict control against gravity.
tips: Keep the bar clear of your forehead as you press and lower.
Keep your chest glued to the bench and avoid arching your lower back to push the bar up.
